test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. W sits third to the left of O. X sits second to the left of Y. O is the immediate neighbour of both N and X. P is not an immediate neighbour of W. How many people sit between M and X when counted from the right of M?
solution:
**Given: **M, N, O, P, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1. W sits third to the left of O.

2. X sits second to the left of Y.

3. O is the immediate neighbour of both N and X.

4. P is not an immediate neighbour of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfd1d3b3b22b875926624d5cda16e7621b7a2e8bf43efdf8333f0a2b1053925d.png] 

M, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c676fb0e584ce82d587665c35c6e1da3a4e7fd81b3e8d2300e59225672a570e.png] 

Thus, two people sit between M and X when counted from the right of M.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
